description: Minute-by-minute timeline for one match: goals with scorer and assist, cards, and substitutions, each with the minute and which side it belongs to. Use for settling scorer, first-goal and card questions. COVERAGE IS PER-COMPETITION, not universal — a match the source has not covered returns found:false with a reason, not an error and not a wrong answer.

_apiKey.description: Optional TheSportsDB key. The free tier serves this tool; a supporter key raises the rate limit.

name: event_timeline
